item.text: The main work is rearranging the concrete separating-heap witnesses. I’m adding pointwise helpers for those rearrangements, then unfolding the finite arrays while preserving their heaps.

arguments.code:
var helpers = `
Lemma finite_trans (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  (P |-- Q) -> (Q |-- R) -> (P |-- R).
Proof. intros HP HQ h H; apply HQ, HP, H. Qed.
Lemma finite_id (P : model -> Prop) : P |-- P.
Proof. intros h H; exact H. Qed.
Lemma finite_frame (P P' Q Q' : model -> Prop) :
  (P |-- P') -> (Q |-- Q') -> (P ** Q |-- P' ** Q').
Proof.
  intros HP HQ h H.
  change (exists a b, join a b h /\\ P a /\\ Q b) in H.
  change (exists a b, join a b h /\\ P' a /\\ Q' b).
  destruct H as [a [b [J [HA HB]]]].
  exists a, b; split; [exact J|split; [apply HP, HA|apply HQ, HB]].
Qed.
Lemma finite_assoc (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  (P ** Q) ** R |-- P ** (Q ** R).
Proof.
  intros h H.
  change (exists ab c, join ab c h /\\ (exists a b, join a b ab /\\ P a /\\ Q b) /\\ R c) in H.
  destruct H as [ab [c [J [[a [b [K [HA HB]]]] HC]]]].
  destruct (join_assoc _ _ _ _ _ K J) as [bc [L M]].
  change (exists a bc, join a bc h /\\ P a /\\ (exists b c, join b c bc /\\ Q b /\\ R c)).
  exists a, bc; split; [exact M|split; [exact HA|]].
  exists b, c; split; [exact L|split; assumption].
Qed.
Lemma finite_comm (P Q : model -> Prop) : P ** Q |-- Q ** P.
Proof.
  intros h H.
  change (exists a b, join a b h /\\ P a /\\ Q b) in H.
  change (exists b a, join b a h /\\ Q b /\\ P a).
  destruct H as [a [b [J [HA HB]]]].
  exists b, a; split; [apply join_comm; exact J|split; assumption].
Qed.
Lemma finite_rotate (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  P ** (Q ** R) |-- Q ** (P ** R).
Proof.
  eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_comm|].
  eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc|].
  apply finite_frame; [apply finite_id|apply finite_comm].
Qed.
Lemma finite_unit (P : model -> Prop) : P |-- P ** emp.
Proof.
  intros h H; destruct (unit_join h) as [u [HU J]].
  change (exists a b, join a b h /\\ P a /\\ emp b).
  exists h, u; split; [exact J|split; assumption].
Qed.
Lemma finite_pure (A : Prop) (P Q : model -> Prop) :
  A -> (P |-- Q) -> (P |-- “ A ” && Q).
Proof. intros HA HP h H; change (A /\\ Q h); split; [exact HA|apply HP, H]. Qed.

Ltac finite_pull A :=
  lazymatch goal with
  | |- ?L |-- _ =>
    lazymatch L with
    | A ** ?R => apply finite_id
    | (?P ** ?Q) ** ?R =>
        eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc|finite_pull A]
    | ?P ** ?Q =>
        eapply finite_trans;
        [apply finite_frame; [apply finite_id|finite_pull A]|apply finite_rotate]
    end
  end.
Ltac finite_heap :=
  first [apply finite_id |
    lazymatch goal with
    | |- ?P |-- “ ?A ” && ?Q =>
        apply finite_pure; [reflexivity|finite_heap]
    | |- (?P ** ?Q) ** ?R |-- ?T =>
        eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc|finite_heap]
    | |- ?L |-- ?A ** ?B =>
        first [eapply finite_trans; [finite_pull A|];
               apply finite_frame; [apply finite_id|finite_heap]
              |eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_unit|];
               apply finite_frame; [apply finite_id|finite_heap]]
    end].
Ltac finite_normalize :=
  unfold CharArray.seg, CharArray.full, CharArray.undef_seg,
    CharArray.undef_full, store_array, store_undef_array;
  cbn [repeat_Z store_array_rec store_undef_array_rec
       StoreCharAsElement.storeA StoreCharAsElement.undefstoreA];
  repeat rewrite sizeof_char; cbn.

`; console.log(helpers);

Require Import ExecutionGoal.
Require Import Coq.ZArith.ZArith.
Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.
Require Import Coq.Strings.String.
Require Import Coq.Strings.Ascii.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import Coq.Classes.RelationClasses.
Require Import Coq.Classes.Morphisms.
Require Import Coq.micromega.Psatz.
Require Import Coq.Sorting.Permutation.
From AUXLib Require Import int_auto Axioms Feq Idents ListLib VMap.
Require Import SetsClass.SetsClass. Import SetsNotation.
From SimpleC.SL Require Import Mem SeparationLogic.
Require Import Logic.LogicGenerator.demo932.Interface.
Local Open Scope Z_scope.
Local Open Scope sets.
Local Open Scope string_scope.
Local Open Scope list.
Import naive_C_Rules.
Local Open Scope sac.
Local Open Scope Z_scope.

Lemma finite_trans (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  (P |-- Q) -> (Q |-- R) -> (P |-- R).
Proof. intros HP HQ h H; apply HQ, HP, H. Qed.
Lemma finite_id (P : model -> Prop) : P |-- P.
Proof. intros h H; exact H. Qed.
Lemma finite_frame (P P' Q Q' : model -> Prop) :
  (P |-- P') -> (Q |-- Q') -> (P ** Q |-- P' ** Q').
Proof.
  intros HP HQ h H.
  destruct H as [a [b H]].
  repeat match type of H with _ /\ _ => destruct H as [? H] end.
  exists a, b; repeat first [assumption | split | apply HP; assumption | apply HQ; assumption].
Qed.
Lemma finite_assoc (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  (P ** Q) ** R |-- P ** (Q ** R).
Proof.
  intros h H; destruct H as [ab [c H]].
  assert (HPQ : (P ** Q) ab) by tauto.
  assert (HC : R c) by tauto.
  assert (J : join ab c h) by tauto.
  destruct HPQ as [a [b K]].
  assert (KJ : join a b ab) by tauto.
  assert (HA : P a) by tauto.
  assert (HB : Q b) by tauto.
  destruct (join_assoc _ _ _ _ _ KJ J) as [bc [L M]].
  exists a, bc; repeat first [assumption | split].
  exists b, c; repeat first [assumption | split].
Qed.
Lemma finite_comm (P Q : model -> Prop) : P ** Q |-- Q ** P.
Proof.
  intros h H; destruct H as [a [b H]].
  assert (J : join a b h) by tauto.
  assert (HA : P a) by tauto.
  assert (HB : Q b) by tauto.
  pose proof (join_comm _ _ _ J) as K.
  exists b, a; repeat first [assumption | split].
Qed.
Lemma finite_rotate (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  P ** (Q ** R) |-- Q ** (P ** R).
Proof.
  eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_comm|].
  eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc|].
  apply finite_frame; [apply finite_id|apply finite_comm].
Qed.
Lemma finite_unit (P : model -> Prop) : P |-- P ** emp.
Proof.
  intros h H; destruct (unit_join h) as [u [HU J]].
  exists h, u; repeat first [assumption | split].
Qed.
Lemma finite_pure (A : Prop) (P Q : model -> Prop) :
  A -> (P |-- Q) -> (P |-- “ A ” && Q).
Proof. intros HA HP h H; change (A /\ Q h); split; [exact HA|apply HP, H]. Qed.

Require Import ExecutionGoal.

From AUXLib Require Import int_auto Axioms Feq Idents ListLib VMap.
Require Import SetsClass.SetsClass. Import SetsNotation.
From SimpleC.SL Require Import Mem SeparationLogic.
Require Import Logic.LogicGenerator.demo932.Interface.
Local Open Scope Z_scope.
Local Open Scope sets.
Local Open Scope string_scope.
Local Open Scope list.
Import naive_C_Rules.
Local Open Scope sac.
Local Open Scope Z_scope.

Lemma finite_trans (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  (P |-- Q) -> (Q |-- R) -> (P |-- R).
Proof. intros HP HQ h H; apply HQ, HP, H. Qed.
Lemma finite_id (P : model -> Prop) : P |-- P.
Proof. intros h H; exact H. Qed.
Lemma finite_frame (P P' Q Q' : model -> Prop) :
  (P |-- P') -> (Q |-- Q') -> (P ** Q |-- P' ** Q').
Proof.
  intros HP HQ h H.
  destruct H as [a [b H]].
  assert (J : join a b h) by tauto.
  assert (HA : P a) by tauto.
  assert (HB : Q b) by tauto.
  pose proof (HP a HA) as HA'.
  pose proof (HQ b HB) as HB'.
  exists a, b; repeat first [assumption | match goal with |- _ /\ _ => split end].
Qed.
Lemma finite_assoc (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  (P ** Q) ** R |-- P ** (Q ** R).
Proof.
  intros h H; destruct H as [ab [c H]].
  assert (HPQ : (P ** Q) ab) by tauto.
  assert (HC : R c) by tauto.
  assert (J : join ab c h) by tauto.
  destruct HPQ as [a [b K]].
  assert (KJ : join a b ab) by tauto.
  assert (HA : P a) by tauto.
  assert (HB : Q b) by tauto.
  destruct (join_assoc _ _ _ _ _ KJ J) as [bc [L M]].
  exists a, bc; repeat first [assumption | match goal with |- _ /\ _ => split end].
  exists b, c; repeat first [assumption | match goal with |- _ /\ _ => split end].
Qed.
Lemma finite_comm (P Q : model -> Prop) : P ** Q |-- Q ** P.
Proof.
  intros h H; destruct H as [a [b H]].
  assert (J : join a b h) by tauto.
  assert (HA : P a) by tauto.
  assert (HB : Q b) by tauto.
  pose proof (join_comm _ _ _ J) as K.
  exists b, a; repeat first [assumption | match goal with |- _ /\ _ => split end].
Qed.
Lemma finite_rotate (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  P ** (Q ** R) |-- Q ** (P ** R).
Proof.
  eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_comm|].
  eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc|].
  apply finite_frame; [apply finite_id|apply finite_comm].
Qed.
Lemma finite_assoc_back (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  P ** (Q ** R) |-- (P ** Q) ** R.
Proof.
  eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_comm|].
  eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc|].
  eapply finite_trans;
    [apply finite_frame; [apply finite_id|apply finite_comm]|apply finite_comm].
Qed.
Lemma finite_unit (P : model -> Prop) : P |-- P ** emp.
Proof.
  intros h H; destruct (unit_join h) as [u [HU J]].
  exists h, u; repeat first [assumption | match goal with |- _ /\ _ => split end].
Qed.
Lemma finite_pure (A : Prop) (P Q : model -> Prop) :
  A -> (P |-- Q) -> (P |-- “ A ” && Q).
Proof. intros HA HP h H; change (A /\ Q h); split; [exact HA|apply HP, H]. Qed.

Ltac finite_pull A :=
  lazymatch goal with
  | |- ?L |-- _ =>
    lazymatch L with
    | A ** ?R => apply finite_id
    | A => apply finite_unit
    | (?P ** ?Q) ** ?R =>
        eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc|finite_pull A]
    | ?P ** ?Q =>
        eapply finite_trans;
        [apply finite_frame; [apply finite_id|finite_pull A]|apply finite_rotate]
    end
  end.
Ltac finite_heap :=
  first [apply finite_id |
    lazymatch goal with
    | |- ?P |-- “ ?A ” && ?Q =>
        apply finite_pure; [reflexivity|finite_heap]
    | |- ?L |-- (?P ** ?Q) ** ?R =>
        eapply finite_trans; [|apply finite_assoc_back]; finite_heap
    | |- (?P ** ?Q) ** ?R |-- ?T =>
        eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc|finite_heap]
    | |- ?L |-- ?A ** ?B =>
        first [eapply finite_trans; [finite_pull A|];
               apply finite_frame; [apply finite_id|finite_heap]
              |eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_unit|];
               apply finite_frame; [apply finite_id|finite_heap]]
    end].
Ltac finite_normalize :=
  cbn [CharArray.seg CharArray.full CharArray.undef_seg
    CharArray.undef_full store_array store_undef_array
    repeat_Z store_array_rec store_undef_array_rec
       StoreCharAsElement.storeA StoreCharAsElement.undefstoreA
       StoreCharAsElement.sizeA];
  repeat rewrite sizeof_char; cbn.
